in_marathi.name: Jayant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit root jaya, meaning 'victory', 'conquer', or 'rule'. Jayant is a name that evokes strength, power, and triumph. In Hindu mythology, Jayant is the name of various deities and figures who represent victory and supremacy. For example, the god Indra, the king of the gods, is sometimes referred to as Jayant. The name is also associated with the concept of time, as in the phrase 'jayant mahavishnu' or 'the ever-expanding Vishnu'.
